source_line: HubSpot portal 4451852 · CRM contacts + Marketing Email Analytics API
intro_html: Built directly from HubSpot's CRM API and marketing-email analytics, contact-level lifecycle stages, nurture-track properties, and per-email send data, as an independent read alongside Tim's own workflow-reporting build. Every section on this page was pulled fresh on Sep 22, 2026. Lifecycle movement is measured from Aug 18, the date the program went live per the Asana launch milestone.

lifecycle.note_html: "Scratch everything else, lifecycle stage movement is the top metric." Contacts currently tagged into a Fall 2026 nurture track whose lifecyclestage advanced (entered MQL, SQL, Opportunity, or Customer) on or after Aug 18, the launch date. Only Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell have usable contact-level tracking right now, see the coverage note below.

coverage.title: Data coverage, worth checking against Tim's read
coverage.html: Every metric above comes from four per-product nurture_track contact properties. Two of them are essentially empty: Great First Eight has zero contacts tagged (out of ~77k) despite 116 emails already delivered per the email-analytics view below, and Agnostic has exactly one, despite 42 delivered. That gap points to the workflow sending mail without writing the nurture-track field back to the contact record, or a different, unmapped property holding that data. World History has no contact-level nurture-track property at all. None of this is guesswork on the email side (that data is real and complete); it's specifically the contact-record tracking that's missing for three of the five programs, which is exactly the kind of thing to compare against whatever Tim's exploration turns up.

portfolio.note_html: Five weeks after the Aug 18 launch, delivery has roughly doubled since the Sep 3 check (2,832 to 5,940). The shape of the send is the thing to read here: every program has delivered its first two modules at full volume, and almost nothing past module 2. That is consistent with a fixed cadence that has not reached module 3 yet, not a fault, but it does mean engagement rates below describe modules 1 and 2 only.

tiles.label: Total delivered across the portfolio, up from 2,832 on Sep 3
tiles.cap: IJ 4,662 · Inkwell 892 · GF8 236 · Agnostic 150 · World History 0. Inquiry Journeys alone is 78% of all delivery.

tiles.label: Unique open rate portfolio-wide, bots excluded
tiles.cap: 1,473 unique opens on 5,940 delivered. By program: Inkwell 29.3%, IJ 24.4%, GF8 22.0%, Agnostic 16.0%. Click rate is 2.3% and unsubscribe 0.54%, inside the under-1% guardrail.

tiles.label: Nurture emails that have sent at all
tiles.cap: 26 of the 49 registered emails have no send data yet. Nearly all are module 3 and later. The ones showing 1 or 2 sends are test sends, not audience delivery.

tiles.label: Sends on World History, still, across all 4 emails
tiles.cap: Unchanged since Aug 31. Either the enrollment audience is empty or the workflow is not live; neither is confirmable through the API. WH also still has no nurture_track__world_history property, checked again Sep 22.

workflows_note_html: Confirmed by Kelsey as the only workflows currently nurturing contacts this fall; everything else in the portal's nurture history is retired. HubSpot's Automation/Workflow objects aren't exposed through the connected API, so enabled/paused state and branch logic still need a manual check in HubSpot, the performance on each card comes from the flow's marketing emails instead.

programs.label: Inquiry Journeys
programs.note_html: Both tracks are running: Leadership modules 1 and 2 (1,060 and 1,103 delivered) and Classroom modules 1 and 2 (1,249 and 1,216). Module 3 has barely started, 12 sends on LT and 2 on CT. Open rate drops from about 28% on module 1 to about 21% on module 2 in both tracks, which is a normal second-touch settle, not a warning. The thing worth explaining is downstream: this program carries 78% of portfolio delivery and has produced exactly one lifecycle stage move.

programs.label: Inkwell
programs.note_html: The strongest engagement in the portfolio on both open and click, and the lowest suppression rate by a wide margin (6% of delivered, against 15% portfolio-wide). Leadership module 1 opens at 33.0%, the best single result anywhere. Unsubscribe is just over the 1% guardrail at 1.01% (9 of 892), worth watching rather than acting on. Inkwell also accounts for 14 of the 15 lifecycle moves since launch.

programs.label: Great First Eight
programs.note_html: Only Leadership modules 1 and 2 have real volume (120 and 112); modules 3 and 4 show 2 sends each, which are tests. Clicks are 2 across the whole program, so no click read is possible yet. Unsubscribe reads 1.27%, above the guardrail, but that is 3 people out of 236 and too thin to act on. GF8 still has no contact-level nurture tracking, so none of it reaches the lifecycle section above.

programs.label: Agnostic
programs.note_html: Suppression is the story: 112 suppressed against 150 delivered, a 75% ratio against 15% portfolio-wide. Two of the four sending emails suppress more than they deliver (module 2: 23 delivered, 30 suppressed; module 3: 22 delivered, 26 suppressed). Open rate is also the lowest of any program at 16.0%, and module 3 sits at 4.5%. Worth checking the suppression lists and frequency caps on this track before reading anything else into the engagement numbers. The cause is not confirmable from the API.

programs.label: World History
programs.note_html: Unchanged across every check since Aug 31. All four World History emails exist and carry the correct nurture property, but none has ever sent. Two possible causes, neither confirmable through the API: the enrollment audience is empty, or the workflow is not switched on. This program also lacks the nurture_track__world_history contact property entirely, re-checked in HubSpot Sep 22, so it has an enrollment list but no active or exited tracking lists and cannot appear in the lifecycle section above.

emails.note_html: Click-to-open rate (clicks ÷ opens, excluding bots) directly from HubSpot's marketing-email analytics, a purer read on content quality than open rate, since it isolates people who opened and then found something worth clicking. Listed: emails with real volume (100+ delivered as of the last pull); everything thinner is too early to rank. CT = Classroom Track (teacher-facing), LT = Leadership Track (admin-facing).
emails.callout_html: Inkwell's Classroom Track emails convert opens to clicks roughly 4x better than its Leadership Track emails (16.7% CTOR across both CT emails vs. 4.4% across both LT emails), even though the LT emails get slightly higher open rates. Teachers who open are clicking; admins who open mostly aren't. Inquiry Journeys can't make the same comparison yet, only one of its Classroom Track emails has meaningful volume so far, the rest of the sequence is still thin.

top_content.note_html: Best email per metric, per program. Bars are scaled per metric type (opened, clicked, exit each on their own scale) so they compare fairly against each other, not against raw percent. Only emails with at least 20 delivered are eligible, which excludes the 1 and 2 send test records that would otherwise show impossible rates like 100% open on a single send. Click "Details" on any tile for the preview text.

audience.role_note_html: Split by the contact's Role property, for the two programs with usable contact-level data. "Admin/Leadership" groups School Leader, District Leader, and Coach/Specialist; "Other/Unassigned" is everyone without a classified role. Both programs look much the same on this cut: roughly half administrators, about a fifth teachers, and the rest unclassified.
audience.source_note_html: Original source (first-touch attribution) for currently-active nurture contacts, IJ and Inkwell.

movement.html: Contacts tagged active/exited in both Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell nurture this season, the only cross-program movement the data shows. GF8 and Agnostic can't be checked for overlap given the tracking gap above; World History has no property to check against.

open_items.html: Inquiry Journeys carries 78% of delivery and has produced one lifecycle move. 4,662 emails delivered to 416 active contacts, and a single contact accounts for IJ’s only MQL, SQL and Customer entry since launch. Inkwell, at less than a fifth of IJ’s volume, produced 14. This is the biggest open question on the program and it is not an email-performance problem: IJ’s open and click rates are healthy.

Nothing has sent past module 2 in any program. 26 of 49 registered emails have no send data; the handful showing 1 or 2 sends are tests. Five weeks post-launch on a spaced cadence, this is expected rather than broken, but it means every engagement rate on this page describes modules 1 and 2 only. Re-check once module 3 is genuinely in flight.

Agnostic suppresses more than it delivers on half its live emails. Program-wide, 112 suppressed against 150 delivered (75%, against 15% portfolio-wide), and modules 2 and 3 each individually suppress more than they send. Worth checking that track’s suppression lists and frequency caps. The cause cannot be confirmed through the API.

World History has still never sent an email, unchanged since Aug 31: 0 delivered across all 4 emails. Either the enrollment audience is empty or the workflow is not live, and neither is readable via API. Separately, the nurture_track__world_history contact property still does not exist (re-checked Sep 22), so WH has an enrollment list but no active or exited tracking lists. That property sits on Tim’s build list and blocks WH from ever appearing in the lifecycle section above.

GF8 and Agnostic still have essentially no contact-level nurture tracking despite actively sending (236 and 150 delivered). Nothing in the lifecycle section can include them. Worth comparing against what Tim’s reporting rebuild finds.

Inkwell’s unsubscribe rate is 1.01% (9 of 892) and GF8’s is 1.27% (3 of 236), both fractionally over the under-1% program guardrail. Both are thin enough that one or two people move the number. Watch, do not act yet.

Tim’s reporting-structure rebuild is still open and is now the binding constraint. It was due Aug 17 and is five weeks overdue in Asana as of Sep 22. This page is a workaround built from raw API pulls; the Tier 1/2/3 reporting it is standing in for is what the Dec 18 program end and Jan 11 postmortem are supposed to read from.
Confirm enabled/paused state and branch logic for all 5 flows directly in HubSpot. Still not readable via API.

Query note for the next refresh: the nurture_track* properties store the internal value Active, while the display label reads "Active - Inkwell Nurture" and so on per product. Filtering on the label returns zero rows silently. Filter on Active.

footnote_html: Source: HubSpot portal 4451852. CRM contact query API (lifecyclestage v2 stage-entry dates, nurture_track properties) and Marketing Email Analytics API (OVERVIEW, per-email, bots excluded), both pulled Sep 22, 2026, scoped to the 5 confirmed Fall 2026 nurture programs via the nurture property on MARKETING_EMAIL. Lifecycle movement measured from Aug 18, 2026, the launch date recorded on the Asana milestone. Email window Jul 30 to Sep 22, 2026. Active-contact counts are contacts currently tagged Active, so contacts who have exited are not counted. Workflow enabled/paused state is not available via API.
